text.text: I love how the place has such high ceiling and warming decorations, the food was amazing from the Chinese cuisine to the European cuisine. Not to mention their salmon sashimi melt in your mouth great choice and quality of fish along side with other sashimis as well. It was a great experience the creamy pasta show inside the parmesan cheese wheel. Definitely was a great experience was just a little upset didn't get the window view, the reception said it was full turns out there are some empty spots left just perfect for 2 persons. Overall the food was not to doubt and the desert is not too sweet light for closing the night.

text.text: A last minute reservation resulted us having some of the poorest seats in the restaurant, but still a five star experience. We got there at 5:30p and our window was until 9:30p. Amazing! Food was fresh and excellent, service was frequent, views were immense and satisfying. Worth the price of admission for the food, time, views, and service. Would definitely visit again.

text.text: We visited for Lunar New Year Eve lunch and the food selection was great. High quality food and beverages. Dining time was 11:30am-2pm. The layout of the restaurant is unconventional, with buffet areas separated into 3 different sides.

Came for family reunion with 19 people. We booked our reservation using app "klook" and pre paid

Reservation based with time slots and limited to 2 hours - arrived early since the clock ticking on time on the dot

Great choices of good selections. Mostly arr Japanese styles of food. Sushi, seafood, grill lamb, few different Chinese style dishes and can't left out the deserts

We sat where we got a greta view of 101 building
